scope: Quick-actions visibility and locked-button click consent are separate default-off device preferences, validated/persisted in the existing voice settings slice and excluded from account synchronization/cache import. Only mute/deafen commands are exposed; remaining widget types are not represented as implemented.

Native Windows uses the existing voice overlay plus one owned nonfocusable 88x40 toolbar surface using the same local renderer entry. Native setShape restricts drawing and hit-testing to two fixed 40x40 DIP islands separated by an eight-DIP gap. The locked voice window remains wholly click-through. No pointer polling, raw mouse hook, screen capture or pointer history is used.

An initially attempted 50ms cursor polling policy was removed after review identified a fast-click race. The final native shape approach enforces the gap at the OS window-region boundary. Shapes are main-owned; the renderer cannot submit arbitrary regions. Shape failure hides the toolbar and surfaces an error; disabling/re-enabling the feature permits retry.

Action IPC accepts only the exact current toolbar renderer/main frame (or the voice renderer while explicitly unlocked), a visible authorized overlay, enabled quick actions, the current auth/join/channel session and an actual matching cursor target. A 250ms bound rejects duplicate actions. The main app rechecks current device consent/session and calls the existing real useVoice mute/deafen commands rather than directly inventing UI state.

Toolbar rendering uses fixed unscaled hit targets, actual self-muted/deafened status, disabled controls without consent, single-flight submission, explicit rejection errors and keyed session lifecycle fencing. Quick actions can remain visible during speaking-only silence while Off/no-call states still hide. Native hide/revoke/close/load callbacks are fenced against resurrecting stale surfaces.
verification: Electron TypeScript compilation and full native suite passed: 145 passed, zero failed, one previously documented host symlink-permission skip. Includes fixed negative-coordinate regions, exclusive edges/gap, consent/frame/session/action/rate checks, native shape/window lifecycle configuration and toolbar geometry during silence.

Independent read-only follow-up confirmed the prior polling race was structurally removed and found no actionable new stale-session/focus/hit-region mismatch. Mocked shapes do not establish real Windows DPI or physical click-through behavior.

Final client TypeScript and scoped ESLint passed. Full client regression passed: 310 files, 2877 tests, zero failures; report C:/Users/PARS/AppData/Local/Temp/hichat-overlay-actions-20261025.json. Production Vite build passed with existing ineffective-dynamic-import warnings.

Native suite re-passed after adding shape creation failure/retry coverage and fencing a stale load callback from clearing a newer surface's pending-load state. All 32 coverage-validator regressions passed; structure VALID, with 41 missing and 175 implemented_unverified. No behavior was marked accepted.
